BrochureContent.Content:
Sherry FitzGerald Geraghty offer to the market, this substantial, 7-bedroom family residence with detached double garage and railed paddock, standing on 1.39ha / 3.43acres of beautifully kept grounds. 
Constructed 1994 in full red brick, this much-loved home offers large living rooms, double bedrooms, extensive cobble lock paths and patios, mature shrub beds and lawns and closed off from the road by electric entrance gates (refurbished May 2026)
The residence and railed paddock are superbly located, just off the N2 - Dublin/Slane Road and offers stunning views across the countryside towards Slane.
The property is perfectly located, allowing easy access to local schools, all major road networks - M1, M2, M3, M50 Interchange and Dublin International Airport. 
With a host of historical interests, locally and a little further afield, this substantial home offers a family a balance of living rooms and bedrooms, at a much sought after address, in the heart of the country, yet close to all services and amenities, both essential and recreational.
For transparency purposes, bidding will be carried out online via our unique bidding platform: MySherryFitz. We suggest you register your interest and you can request a viewing appointment on the platform also
